proof_summary: Split into cases modulo 4 and exhibit the partition \(\{n\}\), \(\{9,n-9\}\), \(\{18,n-18\}\), or \(\{27,n-27\}\), with \(n=27\) handled by \(\{27\}\). The fixed parts are divisible by \(9\), while each complementary part is divisible by \(4\), so all parts are nonsquarefree; the bound \(n>23\) ensures they are positive and distinct.
